sentence_stem: Not only did the team finish the project early,
correct_completion: but they also exceeded every target they had set.
full_sentence: Not only did the team finish the project early, but they also exceeded every target they had set.
acceptable_variants: and they also exceeded every target they had set.
but they also went well beyond every target they had set.

options.text: so they were given an extra budget for next year.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a consequence, but the stem sets up a 'not only ... but also' pattern that needs a second, parallel point of emphasis.

options.text: although they had worked through several weekends.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' introduces a concession that undercuts the positive emphasis rather than adding to it.

options.text: but they also exceeded every target they had set.
because the client had requested a delay.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a cause for the finish, which is unrelated to the 'not only ... but also' structure that calls for an additional achievement.

grammar_focus: Emphatic inversion with 'not only ... but also'
explanation: After a negative phrase such as 'not only', English places the auxiliary 'did' before the subject, which gives the sentence its emphatic force. The second half must add a parallel, equally positive point, so only the option that continues the additive contrast fits. Polish speakers may need reminding that this auxiliary inversion is required after 'not only' and that the sentence needs a 'but also' continuation rather than a cause or a concession.
translation: Nie tylko zespół ukończył projekt przed terminem, ale także przekroczył każdy cel, jaki sobie postawił.
